system: You fill a typed JSON schema for ONE piece of public feedback about SIPs. You never recommend funds or stocks. Evidence spans must be copied character-for-character from the text. Output JSON only.
prompt:
Extract only what the TEXT states about the writer (or, for forum posts describing others, those investors). Leave lists empty and values "unclear" when not stated.

Return:
{"record_id": "youtube_342d8225df7b",
 "checks": [{"what": "returns_or_value"|"nav_or_units"|"instalment_status"|"portfolio_overall"|"other", "frequency": "daily"|"weekly"|"monthly"|"rarely"|"unclear", "evidence_span": "..."}],
 "worries": [{"kind": "losing_money"|"where_is_my_money"|"how_sip_works"|"charges_or_tax"|"app_status_or_error"|"whether_to_continue"|"other", "evidence_span": "..."}],
 "outside_help": [{"channel": "youtube_creator"|"friends_family"|"advisor_agent_bank"|"search_web"|"social_or_forum"|"customer_support"|"other", "evidence_span": "..."}],
 "segment": {"age_band": {"value": "<25"|"25-34"|"35-44"|"45+"|"unclear", "evidence_span": ...},
             "income_stability": {"value": "salaried"|"irregular_or_business"|"student_no_income"|"retired"|"homemaker"|"unclear", "evidence_span": ...},
             "money_source": {"value": "salary_savings"|"lumpsum_or_windfall"|"family_money"|"unclear", "evidence_span": ...},
             "influencer": {"value": "self"|"youtube_creator"|"friends_family"|"advisor_agent_bank"|"ads_or_app"|"unclear", "evidence_span": ...}}}
Rules: checks = what they look at after starting (returns, NAV, whether the instalment went through). worries = confusion or worry about the product or their SIP. outside_help = where they go or who they ask outside the app (a comment on a YouTube video counts as youtube_creator only if they say they rely on such content). Every evidence_span is an exact substring of the text (shorten, never reword or translate); null only when the value is unclear.

CONTEXT (video/topic title, background only): Why SIP will never make you RICH
TEXT:
<<<
Great video, Prateek and team. The only thing I’ll say about SIPs as a 38-year-old is that while what you said is correct - inflation should be accounted for while setting a long-term financial goal in mind - it’s equally important from a discipline standpoint. In my 20s, had someone told me that this accumulates and compounds, it’s likely I would have put a percentage of my take-home into an SIP as savings instead of routing it all into consumption. While I only started SIPs much later, at 32, I do see the benefits of putting aside the 40k-odd every month that I do now. It’s not likely to compound into a massive amount of money but a decent cumulative XIRR of 12-13% over the years should give me at least a decent nest egg for retirement. What I’ve actually benefited more from is the discipline of saving, which should be something that someone in their 20s on a regular salary should consider early, whatever the amount.
>>>
